scope: Selected action-only published-metadata cells; temporal/controller development strata are reported separately

compiled_obligations.evidence: Canonical native decoder observations, independently decoded intended statistics, raw-index units and explicit runtime profile

independent_pointwise.evidence: Exactly the same canonical observations/reference/profile; stateless in this action-only domain

strong_relational.evidence: Exactly the same observations and partial authority, with independently implemented pointwise/paired/midpoint checks

manual_random_designs.evidence: Same domain, eight equal-budget designs and shared oracle; repeated seeds are not independent cases

static_statistics.evidence: Actual intended and deployment statistics, including every explicit intervention

native_roundtrips.evidence: Actual intended/candidate encoders and decoders; self consistency and independent intended-to-candidate comparisons retained separately; auxiliary calls charged

normalization_certificate.evidence: Same designed normalized actions, separately decoded intended/deployed arrays, explicit framework coordinate profiles; no fitted decision or safety threshold

robotruth.evidence: Stock extract_spec plus check_contract on exact shared leaf folders; family=lerobot for these saved source artifacts, including explicit OpenPI transport
robotruth.native_outcome: Preserve passed/findings/summary, allow_unknown=false and no ignored fields or invented overlays
robotruth.credit: Known statistics-identity differences independently of withheld full certification
robotruth.limits: One union hash covers referenced pre/post files and is assigned to both normalizers. Count one underlying artifact difference; byte changes alone do not prove numerical inequivalence.

robot_policy_preflight.limits: Do not invent fields to obtain a native verdict. Native input rejection is separate from incompatibility; normalization-vector structural checks do not establish equality of two statistic bundles.

policy_space.stock_embodiment_schema: N/A_GROUNDED_MAPPING; raw 6/7-coordinate outputs cannot be padded or relabeled as its stock 8-coordinate joint contract
policy_space.primary_source: policy_space_protocol/contracts/registry.py supports POLICY_SPACE_CONTRACTS_DIR; policy_space/conformance.py and runtime/server.py validate selected custom contracts
policy_space.actual_workflow: Stock custom registry, automatic single-pair selection, dispatcher/MessagePack and lifecycle; 520 actual captured decoder outputs replayed as float64 and returned on the native float32 wire; four separately labeled structural negative controls
policy_space.evidence: Same intended/deployment statistics and file identities supplied to service metadata and initialization callback; raw-index contracts without physical embodiment or learned-policy claims
policy_space.interpretation: Transport acceptance is separate from numerical equality, strict artifact identity and certification; no scored semantic miss or superiority result
policy_space.numerical_boundary: Joined numerical verdicts refer to the original float64 decoder before transport. Native float32 wire conversion is measured separately, not silently included in those numerical verdicts.

tether.limits: Full verification unexecuted; prior module controls are separate. No fabricated task success, safety or latency evidence; no miss/false-alarm claim.

missing: two observed state-transition episodes under a grounded response model
actionabi.limits: Decoder queries are not robot transitions. Do not use decoded commands as observed next states or invent timestamps. Credit native equivalence/refusal and separating-probe capabilities from their separate CPU controls.

original_scalar_checker.full_workflow: N/A_ACTION_ONLY; no independently grounded camera/joint/queue/reset bundle for these metadata cells
original_scalar_checker.possible_numeric_projection: NOT_EXECUTED; a separately labeled positive-std MEAN_STD projection is possible but would be a distinct adapter. Independent pointwise arithmetic is already included; do not claim the original checker misses these faults.

xpolicylab.limits: Bounded interface/source audit only; no service or checkpoint adapter comparison and no product-wide absence-of-check claim

reporting_rules: Keep numerical conformance, strict artifact identity, native certification and input/service acceptance in separate columns.
Unavailable evidence, N/A, input rejection and withheld certification are limitations, not semantic misses or false alarms.
Authority/unit erasure does not erase still available artifact bytes; remaining identity findings are legitimate static evidence under their own scope.
Source extractor heuristics are not independently established physical action semantics.
Complete the committed protocol and selected-case gate before prospective outcomes; custom Policy Space transport now has development validation.
